concept: Everyone's voice and vote matters when a group decides something together
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a group makes a decision together by letting everyone have a say, even someone who's usually quiet
exercise.reflection_prompt: Why does it matter that even quiet voices get heard?
exercise.practice: Student participates in a simple group vote or decision exercise with the mentor persona

assessment.success_marker: student can explain why including everyone's voice matters, not just accepting the majority's answer
